newsitem.title: USA: S. Peru Copper to expand capcity.
newsitem.headline: S. Peru Copper to expand capcity.

text.p: Southern Peru Copper Corp said Thursday that when the final expansion of its Cuajone mine and Ilo smelter are completed, sometime after the year 2003, the company could be producing an estimated 930 million pounds of copper annually, or 1.6 times its 1996 level of production.
The company said that reaching that level of production will be achieved through a three-phase expansion plan that started late last year, and will also be dependant on copper prices.
Southern Peru also said that it added 454 million tons of reserves to its capacity in 1996, bringing its total copper ore reserves to 2.7 billion tons.
